test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

We need to __protest__ against this policy.
solution:
The correct answer is '**resist**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Protest**' is '**Resist**'.
 
• **Protest**: a statement or action that shows that you do not like or approve of something. (किसी बात की नापसंदगी या अस्‍वीकृति दिखाने वाला वक्तव्‍य या कार्य; विरोध)
 
 
• *Example: He resigned in **protest** against the decision.*
 
 
 
• **Resist**: to try to stop something happening or to stop somebody from doing something; to fight back against something/somebody. (कुछ घटित होने से या किसी को कुछ करने से रोकने की कोशिश करना; व्‍यकि्त या वस्‍तु का प्रतिरोध या विरोध करना)
 
 
• *Example: The government is resisting pressure to change the law.***
 
 
 

Correct Answer:__** *resist.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **assent**: official agreement to something. (अधिकारिक स्‍वीकृति)
 
• **validate**: to show that something is true. (किसी बात को सत्‍य सिद्घ करना)
 
• **perk**: something extra that you get from your employer in addition to money. (वेतन के अतिरिक्त प्राप्‍त सुविधा या लाभ)
